japanese_evidence.summary: The official V2 README explicitly lists native Japanese support, but it provides no Japanese streaming benchmark or liveconv result.

blocking_reasons: Select and approve an immutable upstream commit.
Select an approved V2 checkpoint bundle and record its SHA-256 digest.

code.notes: The official repository declares OpenVoice V1 and V2 MIT.

weights.notes: The official distribution is presented under MIT; pin and digest the exact bundle before use.

training_data.notes: The reviewed official materials do not provide a complete training-data inventory or license chain.

inference_runtime.notes: Repository inference code is MIT; transitive dependencies still belong in the locked environment review.

audio_contract.notes: Use the approved checkpoint's actual rate. No official stable streaming contract, latency boundary, or liveconv-compatible chunk contract is recorded.

target_preparation.procedure: Validate an authorized reference recording and extract a target speaker embedding once for the frozen offline control run.

resource_budget_hypothesis.notes: Offline-control envelope only. Official sources do not establish a liveconv latency or hardware budget; measure before experiment approval.

blockers.summary: Source revision and weight digest are not approved or pinned.
blockers.clear_when: A reviewed commit, weight SHA-256, and approval record are recorded.

blockers.summary: A complete training-data license inventory is not disclosed in the reviewed official materials.
blockers.clear_when: Governance approves the documented uncertainty for the exact intended offline experiment.

blockers.summary: No authorized target reference or embedding has been selected.
blockers.clear_when: Reference authorization, provenance, checksum, and retention policy are recorded.

blockers.summary: OpenVoice V2 is an offline tone-color control in the current plan, not a streaming adapter.
blockers.clear_when: A later accepted architecture decision and experiment explicitly add streaming scope.

adapter_conformance.criterion: Pass the common offline adapter contract and preserve the offline-control role.

warmup.criterion: Checkpoint and target embedding warm within the frozen offline timeout.

cancel.criterion: Cancel terminates an offline job and publishes no partial artifact as successful.

unload.criterion: Unload releases checkpoints and embeddings; repeated reload remains healthy.

vram.criterion: Peak and post-unload VRAM remain within the preregistered offline budget.

stt.criterion: Japanese STT preservation and exact high-consequence entities pass offline.

speaker.criterion: Authorized-target similarity improves under the calibrated preregistered rule.

integrity.criterion: Finite samples, clipping, duration, silence, repetition, and discontinuity guardrails pass offline.

decision_notes: Use as an offline Japanese-capable control only; successful offline tone-color conversion would not establish realtime streaming suitability.
